headline: Karnataka HC: Making employees work without salary could amount to forced labour
summary: The Karnataka High Court observed that requiring an employee to work without receiving a salary could amount to forced labour ('begar') under Article 23 of the Indian Constitution. The ruling came after a university professor challenged the withholding of his salary during a period of compulsory leave linked to a now-closed criminal case. The court directed the university to review and resolve the professor's representation for withheld wages and arrears within eight weeks.
